title: Billing-Error Credits in the Insurance Claim Services Credited-Line Write-Off
content:
**Rule.** For the credited-line write-off of Insurance Claim Services, the billing-error credits are narrowed as follows: when the estimate was submitted on or before the water job's drying complete date, none, because an estimate built from the scope sheet carried the measured quantities, never the over-billed ones; when it was submitted after the drying complete date but before the invoiced date, only the billing error credits against the job's equipment-day lines dated on its last equipment day (one line per equipment type per day), because that estimate priced equipment through the last logged day from the daily log and every other line from the scope sheet; otherwise every billing error credit posted on the job, because an estimate built from the invoice carried the invoiced mitigation lines with their over-billed quantities.

The estimate submission date is the claim file's; the drying complete date, the invoiced date, the equipment-day lines and the billing error adjustment credits are those of the Water Damage Mitigation job. The last equipment day is the latest service date among the job's equipment-day lines.

## Timeline

| Estimate submitted | Billing error credits counted |
|---|---|
| on or before the drying complete date | none |
| after the drying complete date, before the invoiced date | only those correcting an equipment-day line dated on the last equipment day |
| on or after the invoiced date | every billing error credit posted on the job |

*Hypothetical:* drying complete 12 March, invoiced 20 March, last equipment day 12 March, billing error credits of 88.00 (against an air mover line of 12 March) and 140.00 (against a monitoring visit). Estimate submitted 12 March: none. Submitted 15 March: 88.00. Submitted 20 March: both, 228.00.
